derivations.method: Off-duty printed 19:05/00:05Z with no +1 flag; the Zulu value belongs to the next calendar day (ORD local 19:05 on 04SEP = 00:05Z on 05SEP, confirmed by to_utc). Only the UTC date was derived, not the time.

Report printed 20:20/00:20Z on a row dated 16SEP with no +1 flag; JFK local 20:20 on 16SEP = 00:20Z on 17SEP per to_utc, so the entire duty carries UTC date 17SEP. Time taken as printed; only the date was derived.
Off-duty printed 07:05/23:05Z+1; the +1 belongs to the SIN local clock (07:05 on 19SEP), so the Zulu value 23:05Z stays on 18SEP. Verified against the STA pair 06:35/22:35Z+1 via to_utc.
STA 00:50/23:50Z+1 is 23:50Z on 20SEP (to_utc: LHR local 00:50 on 21SEP = 23:50Z on 20SEP), but off-duty 01:20/00:20Z+1 crosses midnight in UTC too, giving 00:20Z on 21SEP.
Report printed 00:25/23:25Z; LHR local 00:25 on 27SEP = 23:25Z on 26SEP per to_utc, so the report instant precedes the row's own date. Time as printed; date derived.
